title: A Green Sea
summary: The moon fell on everyone but you, and you made a world of what was left.

epilogue.title: The New Realm
epilogue.text: The heroes made a green wild, all fern and rain, where the old dead walk the shallows and nobody is afraid of the dark.

epilogue.title: The New Realm
epilogue.text: The heroes made a city of light, on a hill, with no gate and no curfew, and a clocktower that tolls only for weddings.

epilogue.title: The New Realm
epilogue.text: The heroes made quiet farmland, long and low, where the work is done by evening and the stars stay put.

epilogue.title: The New Realm
epilogue.text: The heroes remade their own homeland, as it was and as it should have been, in one green sea of rebirth.

epilogue.title: The New Realm
epilogue.text: The heroes shaped a new realm out of the green sea, and it is theirs, and it is gentle, and nobody there remembers the fall.
